findings: Required invested-point thresholds are established by ProfTraitPerkNode and match the live calculator. Free path unlock is a separate zero-invested-point perk, not one invested point.

Delegate and matching Dust or Supplier skill arithmetic: base + invested points + learning bonus5 + satisfied milestone bonuses; max Delegate70 and matching child80 if each is learned and30 invested points.

Crystal uses the same effect146 Amount1 as the three explicitly described per-point Skill nodes, and the same label5052 and enum25 as its explicitly Epic Skill milestones. This supports a sourced provisional inference of +1skill per invested point. Combined with50learning/milestone skill, the max is80 at30points; no skill-to-output curve is thereby established.

Dust and Supplier unlock additional main-material procs at20 invested points. Crystal unlocks native magical essence extraction at20. At30 Dust/Crystal enhance the existing chance; Supplier adds additional-material extraction. Chance and stack distributions are not stated.
All20-point proc traits have zero ProfessionTraitXEffect rows. At30 the linked numeric effect is only the stated20 skill/points-label amount; no separately stated numeric proc probability appears.

SpellLabel5049(root) and5050(Dust) bind to Radiant Shatter1280394;5049 and5051(Supplier) bind to Dawn Shatter1280401. No5052(Crystal) SpellLabel row and no labels on Disenchant13262 exist in this snapshot.
Disenchant13262 has effect99 with no CraftingData pointer, numeric coefficients or base quantity. ItemDisenchantLoot identifies eligible rarity/class/expansion brackets only.

Shatter recipes use effect296 and ItemSalvage248/249. Their CraftingData8096/8097 are type2, difficultyID0/difficulty0, with no CraftingDataItemQuality or EnchantQuality rows. ItemSalvageLoot maps input quality IDs to server Treasure IDs. The retrieved client tables do not expose those Treasure distributions.

A deterministic milling/prospecting quality threshold cannot be inferred for disenchanting or shattering from the retrieved data. No general skill-to-rank probability curve or bonus-material quantity/proc formula was found in the checked tables.

implementationLimits.zeroPoints: Unlearned and learned-with-zero-points are different states. Store or capture explicit path learning state before granting the free+5 skill perk.
implementationLimits.serverBehavior: The absence of a coefficient in these checked tables does not prove no coefficient exists in all Blizzard data. It proves these retrieved public client routes cannot justify one.
implementationLimits.cohortPolicy: Existing measured full-specialization references may be selected only at matching allocations; do not infer arbitrary-point curves or additional multipliers from them.
implementationLimits.crystalInference: Per-point Skill is inferred from exact primary definition/trait/effect/label joins, not quoted from Crystal base prose. Independently reviewed by formula_game_data and formula_addons; not directly measured in game. Keep provisional source attribution.
